policy.cohort: warm first unseen target; all requests in denominator
policy.base_order: locked M11 learned score descending, then item ID ascending
policy.category: train-cutoff catalog only; missing category earns no novelty bonus
policy.utility: 1 - zero-based shortlist rank / max(shortlist length - 1, 1), plus bonus for an unselected known category

selection.objective: strictly higher distinct known category slots, then HR hits, NDCG, smaller bonus; otherwise zero

policy.ranker_training: earlier labelled folds in development; frozen folds 1–4 model in diagnostic
policy.no_als_ranker: unchanged full-hybrid trained model and schema; transfer, no pool-specific refit
policy.selection: separate warm/cold pooled hits@20, NDCG@20 sum, fewer sources, smaller bonus, policy name
policy.denominator: all cohort user-windows, including catalog-unreachable and pool-missed targets
policy.latency_sample: ascending SHA-256 of fold:user; rotate fixed policy order by repetition/request
policy.latency_scope: complete target-free offline inference with prebuilt context and fitted snapshot; no data load, fitting, network or API
policy.cold_latency_scope: repeated identical empty context; cohort quality counted in full
